free_tier.stated: RUB 500 per month for MSK-PRO-1: 1 vCPU at 2.50 GHz, 2 GB RAM, 25 GB NVMe, up to 500 Mbit/s, Moscow, KVM, with administration help included. The page's own floor is RUB 400 per month when 24 months are paid up front. The three larger rows are RUB 1,000 (2 vCPU / 4 GB / 50 GB), RUB 1,900 (4 vCPU / 8 GB / 100 GB) and RUB 3,600 (8 vCPU / 16 GB / 200 GB), all at 2.50 GHz and 500 Mbit/s.

egress.terms: up to 500 Mbit/s per row, no byte allowance and no overage price stated

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.tooling: order through my.serv-tech.ru (BILLmanager); no API documented on the page read
record.chaining: Two gigabytes and 25 GB of NVMe in Moscow at RUB 500 with administration included is the cheapest row among documented hosts that carries a support commitment, which matters where a broken box costs a day

limits.value: Every row is stated as a 500 Mbit/s channel with no per-byte payment and no monthly volume cap; the channel is shared, constant maximum load 24/7 is not allowed, and a speed restriction is possible after prolonged excessive load.
